title: Felvidék and Vajdaság: Bilingual Cities and Cultural Bridges
grammar: Irrealis concessive conditionals: még ha ... is / még ha ... volna is ('even if ... were / had been')
goal: I can describe Hungarian community life in southern Slovakia (Felvidék) and northern Serbia (Vajdaság).
I can construct irrealis and hypothetical concessive conditional sentences using még ha ... is / még ha ... volna is.
I can discuss bilingual public signage, Danube bridge connections, and multicultural borderland identity.
